# beowulf-fitt-38 — cruces worth recording in QUESTIONS.md

Each: line · word · what was chosen · why disputed or guessed.

- 2754–55 · `brogdne beadusercean` · "woven battle-shirt"; masculine ending on `brogdne` with feminine `serce`, unexplained, taken loosely. Italic `n` of `under` (MS `urder`; Thorkelin `under`).
- 2756 · `bī sesse` · "by the seat", a stone ledge in the barrow (guess).
- 2757 · `fealo` · "many"; Kemble `fela`, Rieger/Sedgefield `feola`.
- 2759 · `ond þæs wyrmes denn` · "and the worm's den"; Thorpe, Holthausen, Sedgefield `geond` "throughout".
- 2760 · `orcas` · "cups" (from Latin `orca`); `stondan` vs `stōdan` (Ettmüller, Holthausen etc.).
- 2761 · `feormendlēase` · "without polishers".
- 2764 · `searwum gesǣled` · "skilfully bound" (guess).
- 2764–66 · gnomic aside, `oferhīgian` · "overpower", from `hīgian` "strive" (guess); Kluge `-hȳdgian`, Schücking `-hīdgian`, Grundtvig/Sedgefield¹ `-hīwian`, Sedgefield² `ofer hige hēan`. `grund(e)` ending from Grundtvig's transcript. Point of the aside (hiding gold in earth does not save the hider) is an interpretation.
- 2769 · `leoðocræftum` · "limb-crafts" = handiwork (guess; alternative `lēoþ` "song", magic craft). Italic `a` of `lēoma` (MS `leoman`).
- 2771 · `wrǣte` · accusative plural "jewels"; MS `wræce`, Thorpe `wrǣte`.
- 2775 · `hladon` · taken as infinitive (parallel to `rēafian`); MS `hlodon`, Grundtvig/Sedgefield `hladan`. `bunan` "cups" (guess).
- 2777 · `Bill ǣr gescọ̄d ealdhlāfordes` · "the old lord's sword had before harmed"; old lord = Beowulf (inference); Kemble `ǣrgescōd` "brass-shod"; Rieger, Aantekeningen, Sedgefield `-hlāforde` (the dragon).
- 2781 · `hioroweallende` · "surging with swords" (guess).
- 2783 · `Ār` · "messenger" (Wīglāf); `gefyrðred` "furthered", i.e. laden (guess).
- 2785 · `collenferð` · "bold-hearted", nominative (guess); Ettmüller `-ferðne` (accusative, of Beowulf).
- 2791 · `wæteres weorpan` · "throw water at, sprinkle"; Kemble etc. `wætere`; Rieger/Trautmann `wætere sweorfan`.
- 2792 · `[Biorncyning spræc]` · bracketed emendation, "[The warrior-king spoke]"; Grundtvig `[Bēowulf maþelode]`, Schücking `[Þā se beorn gespræc]`, Holthausen/Chambers `[Bīowulf reordode]`.
- 2793 · `giohðe` · "sorrow"; MS `giogoðe` "youth".
- 2799–2800 · `bebohte … mīne frōde feorhlege` · "sold my old life-laying" (`feorhlege` = laying down of life, guess); italic `ne` of `mīne` (MS `minne`).
- 2800 · `fremmað gēna` · plural imperative to a single listener, "do you still provide for"; most editors `gē nū`. Guess.
- 2802 · `heaðomǣre` · accusative plural "the battle-famed"; `beorhtne` vs `beorht` (Sievers, Holthausen).
- 2804 · `sē scel` · masculine pronoun for the barrow; Sievers/Holthausen `þæt`.
- 2805 · `Hronesnæsse` · "Whale's Ness" vs personal name, left as printed.
- 2807 · `brentingas` · "steep-ones", high-prowed ships (hapax, guess).
- 2812 · `bēah` · listed as a second ring beside `hring gyldenne`.
- 2814 · `forswēop` · MS `forspeof`, Kemble `-swēop`; italics `wēop`.
- 2818–19 · `hāte heaðowylmas` · "hot battle-surges" = pyre flames (guess).
- 2819 · `hræðre` · MS `hwæðre`, Kemble `hreðre`, Grein `hræðre`.
- 2820 · `sōðfæstra dōm` · "doom of the truth-fast"; `dōm` could be "judgement" or "glory".
